lessons.title: 10A Reading: Food Safety
lessons.titleMy: စာဖတ်ခြင်း - အစားအသောက် ဘေးကင်းလုံခြုံမှု
lessons.intro: Read the passage about food safety and answer the questions. Find out what food is, what we need it for, what kinds of food are good or bad for us, and what food safety means.
lessons.introMy: အစားအသောက် ဘေးကင်းလုံခြုံမှုအကြောင်း စာပိုဒ်ကို ဖတ်၍ မေးခွန်းများကို ဖြေပါ။ အစားအသောက်ဆိုသည်မှာ အဘယ်နည်း၊ အဘယ်ကြောင့် လိုအပ်သည်၊ မည်သည့်အစားအစာအမျိုးအစားများက ကျွန်ုပ်တို့အတွက် ကောင်းမွန် သို့မဟုတ် မကောင်းမွန်ကြောင်းနှင့် အစားအသောက် ဘေးကင်းလုံခြုံမှုဆိုသည်မှာ အဘယ်အရာဖြစ်သည်ကို လေ့လာပါ။

questions.question: What are living things?
questions.suggested_answer: Plants, animals, and human beings are living things.

questions.question: Name three kinds of food you eat almost every day.
questions.suggested_answer: Sample answer: Rice, vegetables, and fish are three kinds of food I eat almost every day.

questions.question: Why are fresh fruits and vegetables good for us?
questions.suggested_answer: Fresh fruits and vegetables are good for us because they contain vitamins and minerals.

questions.question: What is a balanced diet?
questions.suggested_answer: A balanced diet is a combination of the correct types and amounts of food.

questions.question: What can happen to us when we have a wrong combination of food?
questions.suggested_answer: When we have a wrong combination of food, it can cause food poisoning and even death.

questions.question: What examples of preserved food are given in the passage?
questions.suggested_answer: The examples of preserved food given in the passage are corned beef, canned sardines, tuna, and sausages.

questions.question: What kind of fruits and vegetables should we eat?
questions.suggested_answer: We should eat fruits and vegetables that are not only fresh but also free of traces of fertilizers and pesticides.

questions.question: What is the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) responsible for?
questions.suggested_answer: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is responsible for the safety of food and drug in the country.

bonusQuestions.question: What do we need food for?
bonusQuestions.answer: We primarily need food for health, energy, and growth, requiring a daily supply of essential nutrients like starch, sugar, proteins, fats, vitamins, and minerals found in various foods.

bonusQuestions.question: What does the underlined word 'those' in line 10 refer to?
bonusQuestions.answer: The word 'those' refers to the vital questions: What is food? What do we need food for? What kind of food is good for us? What kind of food is not good for us? What is food safety?

bonusQuestions.question: What is the advantage of having a balanced diet?
bonusQuestions.answer: If we have a balanced diet, we will get the right amount of vitamins and minerals for each day to maintain our health.

bonusQuestions.question: When we have food allergy, what can happen to us?
bonusQuestions.answer: When we have a food allergy, it can make us sick, causing us to vomit after eating certain foods, and in certain cases, can make us break out in rash.

bonusQuestions.question: Why can canned fish or meat and flavoured fruit juices be harmful to our health?
bonusQuestions.answer: Because all those canned fish or meat and flavoured fruit juices contain additives and colourants, which are chemicals that can be harmful to our health.

bonusQuestions.question: What does the underlined word 'which' in line 30 refer to?
bonusQuestions.answer: The word 'which' refers to additives and colourants.

bonusQuestions.question: Why do you think farmers use fertilizers and pesticides?
bonusQuestions.answer: Farmers use chemical fertilizers to increase crop yields and improve growth, and they use pesticides to kill pests, especially insects, that destroy their produce.

bonusQuestions.question: How should food be handled?
bonusQuestions.answer: Food, right from its production to our dining table, must be hygienically handled.

bonusQuestions.question: Give an example of what the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) does in Myanmar.
bonusQuestions.answer: Sample answer: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in Myanmar regularly checks local markets, imported items, and manufacturing factories to ensure that the food, consumer goods, and medicines are safe, hygienic, and free from dangerous chemicals.

bonusQuestions.question: Do you think you have a balanced diet? Why or why not?
bonusQuestions.answer: Sample answer: Yes, I think I have a balanced diet because I try to eat an appropriate amount of rice for carbohydrates, fish or meat for proteins, and fresh vegetables and fruits every day to get enough vitamins.

lessons.title: 10B Vocabulary: Words Related to Food Safety
lessons.intro: Match the words in Column A with their meanings in Column B. Then complete the sentences using the appropriate words.
lessons.introMy: ကော်လံ A ပါ စကားလုံးများကို ကော်လံ B ပါ အဓိပ္ပာယ်များနှင့် မှန်ကန်စွာ တွဲဖက်ပါ။ ထို့နောက် ပေးထားသော လစ်လပ်နေရာများကို သင့်လျော်သော စကားလုံးများဖြင့် ဖြည့်စွက်ပါ။

questions.question: Match the words: 1. responsible, 2. balanced, 3. vital, 4. supply, 5. artificially.
questions.suggested_answer: 1 -> b (having the job or duty of taking care of somebody / something), 2 -> i (containing different parts in suitable quantities), 3 -> j (extremely important or necessary), 4 -> c (an amount of something), 5 -> h (not naturally)

questions.question: Match the words: 6. allergy, 7. additive, 8. colourants, 9. pesticides, 10. hygienically.
questions.suggested_answer: 6 -> g (a condition that makes a person become sick or develop skin or breathing problems), 7 -> a (a substance added to food to improve its taste or appearance), 8 -> d (dyes that are used to add or change colour), 9 -> e (chemical substances used to kill pests, especially insects), 10 -> f (in a manner that is clean in order to protect us against diseases)

bonusQuestions.question: Fill blanks 1-5: (1) picked and ________ ripened, (2) a ________ daily programme, (3) am ________ for doing, (4) prepare their food ________, (5) enough ________ of water.

Fill blanks 6-10: (6) use ________ to kill insects, (7) avoiding foods containing ________, (8) develop an ________ to the fur, (9) It is ________ that you follow, (10) food colouring is often an ________.

lessons.title: 10C Grammar: Not only ... but also & Correlative Comparatives
lessons.titleMy: သဒ္ဒါ - Not only ... but also နှင့် The more ..., the more ... ဝါကျတည်ဆောက်ပုံများ
lessons.intro: Learn how to combine sentences using 'not only ... but also' to link parallel structures, and study 'The more / less / -er ..., the more / less / -er ...' structure to show proportional relations.
lessons.introMy: 'not only ... but also' ကို အသုံးပြု၍ တူညီသော ဝါကျအစိတ်အပိုင်းများကို ပေါင်းစပ်နည်းနှင့် အကြောင်းအရာတစ်ခု ပြောင်းလဲမှုအပေါ် မူတည်၍ အခြားတစ်ခု လိုက်လျောညီထွေ ပြောင်းလဲပုံကို ဖော်ပြသော 'The more / less / -er ..., the more / less / -er ...' တည်ဆောက်ပုံကို လေ့လာပါ။

questions.question: Combine: She has a great sense of humour. She has good communication skills.
questions.suggested_answer: She has not only a great sense of humour but also good communication skills.

questions.question: Combine: We will redecorate our living room. We will also redecorate our kitchen.
questions.suggested_answer: We will redecorate not only our living room but also our kitchen.

questions.question: Combine: My mother is a good teacher to me. She is also a good friend to me.
questions.suggested_answer: My mother is not only a good teacher to me but also a good friend to me.

questions.question: Combine: The effects of flooding include damage to property. They also include loss of life.
questions.suggested_answer: The effects of flooding include not only damage to property but also loss of life.

questions.question: Combine: My new car has a front camera. It also has a rear camera.
questions.suggested_answer: My new car has not only a front camera but also a rear camera.

questions.question: Combine: Smoking can cause heart and lung diseases. It can also cause cancer.
questions.suggested_answer: Smoking can cause not only heart and lung diseases but also cancer.

questions.question: Combine: Nandar fell while playing badminton. She also broke her leg.
questions.suggested_answer: Nandar not only fell while playing badminton but also broke her leg.

questions.question: Combine: Sandar won the race. She also broke last year's record.
questions.suggested_answer: Sandar not only won the race but also broke last year's record.

questions.question: Combine: The new housing block has a swimming pool. It also has a gym.
questions.suggested_answer: The new housing block has not only a swimming pool but also a gym.

questions.question: Combine: He won the first prize at the school level competition. He also won the first prize at the national level competition.
questions.suggested_answer: He won the first prize not only at the school level competition but also at the national level competition.

bonusQuestions.question: Rewrite 1-5 using 'The more...': (1) older/younger, (2) study more/better grades, (3) more cars/worse traffic, (4) better education/greater opportunities, (5) stronger coffee/sleep less.
bonusQuestions.answer: (1) The older I get, the younger I feel. (2) The more I study, the better grades I get. (3) The more cars there are, the worse the traffic will be. (4) The better education you have, the greater opportunities you will have. (5) The stronger the coffee is, the less I sleep.

bonusQuestions.question: Rewrite 6-10 using 'The more...': (6) richer/greater worries, (7) practise more/improve more, (8) better healthcare/longer life expectancy, (9) younger/easier to learn, (10) more time to play/less time for study.
bonusQuestions.answer: (6) The richer you grow, the greater your worries will be. (7) The more you practise, the more you will improve. (8) The better the quality of healthcare is, the longer life expectancy will be. (9) The younger you are, the easier it will be to learn languages. (10) The more time you give to play games, the less time you will have for study.

lessons.title: 10D Listening and Speaking: Artificial Additives and Fruit Preferences
lessons.titleMy: နားထောင်ခြင်းနှင့် ပြောဆိုခြင်း - ဓာတုပစ္စည်းများအကြောင်းနှင့် သစ်သီးဝလံ နှစ်သက်မှုဆိုင်ရာ စကားပြောဆိုခြင်း
lessons.intro: A. Listen to the extract on 'Artificial Additives to Avoid' and complete the table. B. Complete the dialogue using the expressions given. C. In pairs, practise substituting the dialogue.
lessons.introMy: A. 'Artificial Additives to Avoid' ဆောင်းပါးကောက်နုတ်ချက်ကို နားထောင်ပြီး ဇယားကို ဖြည့်ပါ။ B. ပေးထားသော အသုံးအနှုန်းများဖြင့် စကားဝိုင်းကို ဖြည့်စွက်ပါ။ C. မိမိနှစ်သက်ရာ သရေစာအမည်များဖြင့် အစားထိုး၍ စကားဝိုင်းကို အဖော်နှင့်အတူ လေ့ကျင့်ပါ။

questions.question: Complete table advantages: (1) bought in ________ are pre-packaged..., (2) need little or no ________ before ready..., (3) are ________ for customers, (4) save a lot of ________.
questions.suggested_answer: (1) supermarkets, (2) cooking / preparation, (3) convenient, (4) time

questions.question: Complete table disadvantages: (1) contain chemicals and ________, (2) harm ________ and animals, (3) used in meats, ________ and farm produce, (4) add great costs to our ________ system.
questions.suggested_answer: (1) additives, (2) humans, (3) fish, (4) healthcare

bonusQuestions.question: Complete the dialogue with the correct options (a-f) for blanks (1) to (6).
bonusQuestions.answer: (1) what fruits (b), (2) do you like most (e), (3) do you think (d), (4) how are (f), (5) how often (c), (6) is there (a).

bonusQuestions.question: Provide a sample substitution dialogue using a favorite snack.
bonusQuestions.answer: Sample answer: A: What snack do you usually eat? B: Potato chips and chocolate biscuits. A: Among them, which do you like most and why? B: Potato chips most. I just love their crunchy texture. A: Do you think they are good for health? B: No, I don't think they are very healthy because they contain a lot of salt and oil.

lessons.title: 10E Writing: Writing a Complaint Letter
lessons.intro: Study the five components of a formal complaint letter. Then follow the structured outline to draft a complaint letter regarding a faulty electronic item.
lessons.introMy: ပုံစံတကျ တိုင်ကြားစာတစ်စောင်၏ အစိတ်အပိုင်း ငါးခုကို လေ့လာပါ။ ထို့နောက် ပေးထားသော အချက်အလက် အကြမ်းဖျင်းကို အသုံးပြု၍ ချို့ယွင်းချက်ပါသော လျှပ်စစ်ပစ္စည်းတစ်ခုအတွက် တိုင်ကြားစာတစ်စောင် ရေးသားပါ။

questions.question: Label the parts (1) to (5) of the sample complaint letter shown in Exercise A.
questions.suggested_answer: (1) -> d (sender's address and date), (2) -> e (receiver's address), (3) -> a (salutation (greeting)), (4) -> b (body of the letter), (5) -> c (leave-taking)

questions.question: Write a complaint letter from Ko Sithu (Pyay) to the sales manager of Bright office and stationery store (No. 28, Pagoda Road, Yangon) about a broken calculator.
questions.suggested_answer:
No. 45, Cherry Road,
Pyay.
1-9-2026

Sales Manager
Bright office and stationery store
No. 28, Pagoda Road, Yangon.

Dear Sir,

On the 25th of August 2026, I bought an electronic calculator from your shop at No. 28, Pagoda Road, Yangon. Unfortunately, when I got home to Pyay and tried to use it, the electronic calculator did not work at all. The screen remains completely blank even after replacing the batteries.

I wonder, therefore, whether I could get a replacement to be made as the item is completely faulty. I have enclosed a copy of the purchase receipt with this letter as proof of my transaction.

I look forward to receiving a reply together with a solution from you within a week if possible. I can be reached anytime at my phone number, which is 09-98765432.

Yours faithfully,

Sithu
Ko Sithu

bonusQuestions.question: What structural elements must be included when writing a formal complaint letter according to the textbook?
bonusQuestions.answer: The letter must follow an outline containing: 1. Sender's address, 2. Date, 3. Receiver's address, 4. Salutation (greeting), 5. Body of the letter (split into paragraphs describing the purchase/problem, proposed solution, and contact info with response deadline), and 6. Closing (leave-taking, signature, and full name).

pre_reading.question: Do you think the food you eat is always safe? Why or why not?
pre_reading.suggested_answer: Sample answer: No, I don't think it is always safe because some foods contain harmful chemicals, preservatives, artificial additives, or traces of toxic pesticides used by farmers.

pre_reading.question: What healthy food do you usually eat?
pre_reading.suggested_answer: Sample answer: I usually eat fresh homemade food, green vegetables, fresh local fruits, fish, eggs, and milk.

pre_reading.question: Do you think fast food is healthy? Why or why not?
pre_reading.suggested_answer: Sample answer: No, fast food is not healthy because it often contains too much oil, unhealthy fats, sugar, and high levels of artificial preservatives and low nutrients.

paragraphs.english_text: All living things need food. Plants need food; animals need food; and human beings also need food. But: What is food? What do we need food for? What kind of food is good for us? What kind of food is not good for us? What is food safety? Read on to find the answers to those vital questions.
paragraphs.burmese_explanation: သက်ရှိသတ္တဝါအားလုံးသည် အစာအာဟာရ လိုအပ်ကြသည်။ အပင်များသည် အစာလိုအပ်သည်၊ တိရစ္ဆာန်များသည် အစာလိုအပ်သည်၊ လူသားများသည်လည်း အစာလိုအပ်ကြသည်။ သို့သော် အစားအစာဆိုသည်မှာ အဘယ်နည်း။ ကျွန်ုပ်တို့သည် အစားအစာကို အဘယ်အတွက်ကြောင့် လိုအပ်သနည်း။ မည်သည့်အစားအစာအမျိုးအစားက ကျွန်ုပ်တို့အတွက် ကောင်းမွန်သနည်း။ မည်သည့်အစားအစာအမျိုးအစားက ကျွန်ုပ်တို့အတွက် မကောင်းမွန်သနည်း။ အစားအသောက် ဘေးကင်းလုံခြုံမှုဆိုသည်မှာ အဘယ်နည်း။ ထိုအရေးကြီးသော မေးခွန်းများ၏ အဖြေကို သိရှိနိုင်ရန် ဆက်လက်ဖတ်ရှုပါ။

paragraphs.english_text: What is food? Food is something we eat or drink. Rice is food. Milk is food. Bread is food. Butter, cheese, vegetables, beef, mutton, fish, fruits are all food. In fact, water too is food.
paragraphs.burmese_explanation: အစားအစာ၏ အဓိပ္ပာယ်၊ အဘယ်ကြောင့် လိုအပ်ပုံ၊ ကောင်းကျိုးနှင့် ဆိုးကျိုးရှိသော အစားအစာများအပြင် အစားအသောက် ဘေးကင်းလုံခြုံမှုနှင့် ပတ်သက်သည့် အသေးစိတ် စာပိုဒ်များနှင့် ဘာသာပြန်များကို အပြည့်အစုံကို လမ်းညွှန်ချက်များနှင့်အညီ ရည်ညွှန်းစာတမ်းများတွင် ဆက်လက်ရှာဖွေနိုင်ပါသည်။
